Hello, I went to Cinderella pet shop on Saturday to look at a songbird, and there were two canaries: a beautiful yellow one and a very beautiful green one. I asked if it sings, and the answer was yes; it was said to be singing its heart out. I bought the bird, put it in the cage when I got home, and after about two hours, it didn't stop beaking. This morning, it was singing again immediately. Super bird, very happy with it. Everything in the shop looks immaculately maintained; both the bird enclosure and the aquariums look great.
Nice pet shop with knowledgeable staff

Yesterday, I visited this store with my children to look at goldfish and possibly birds. We first asked about a small aquarium/enclosure and then about the price of the birds. Initially, the employee refused to give the price, claiming that I didn't know what I wanted to buy myself yet. Eventually, he did give the price, but only after an unpleasant remark. This was despite the fact that I just wanted to browse quietly for my children. Because of his reaction, I didn't feel very welcome in the store. Therefore, I prefer a different pet specialty store.

On September 6, 2024, my Pomeranian had an appointment with Cinderella. Prior to the appointment, I discussed my wishes over the phone. I emphasized that this was a Pomeranian requiring specific coat care, and I was assured that they had extensive experience with this. I was told that everything would turn out fine.

On the day itself, I dropped off my dog, but he was picked up later by a friend. Shortly afterward, I received a call from her, who said she did not recognize my dog. When I saw the photos (see photos 1 & 2), I was shocked: he had been cut way too short, the finish was sloppy, and it did not look professional at all. Clearly someone without experience with this breed.

I was incredibly sad and angry. Cinderella's only explanation was that my dog ​​had "too many tangles" and that she "couldn't get through them." But instead of contacting me about this, she decided to cut drastically without consulting me. That is unacceptable.

The worst part is that his coat will never be the same again (photo 3). Anyone who owns a Pomeranian knows how important the coat is and how long it takes – if it grows back at all. No form of compensation whatsoever, just a lame excuse.
